SLAY_THE_SPIRE2_MGR_MOD_RELIC_MINI_MICRO: At the start of combat, channel an Attack, Skill, and Power note in that order.
Ready to show the Spire your voice?
SLAY_THE_SPIRE2_MGR_MOD_RELIC_PERPETUAL_: At the start of each turn, generate an Attack, Skill, and Power Note in that order. On the first turn, also generate a Starry Note.
The song never ends. It only enters the next measure.
SLAY_THE_SPIRE2_MGR_MOD_RELIC_MGR_FUMO.d: At the start of combat, gain 1 Forte.
SLAY_THE_SPIRE2_MGR_MOD_RELIC_MGR_FUMO.f: A soft little stand-in for the star of the stage.
SLAY_THE_SPIRE2_MGR_MOD_RELIC_MINI_STAGE: The first Performance card you manually play each turn Performs 1 additional time.
Even after the song ends, the lights refuse to fade.
SLAY_THE_SPIRE2_MGR_MOD_RELIC_BOOK_OF_GR: At the start of combat, generate 1 Attack Note. For every 5 damage taken during the journey since obtaining this relic, generate 1 additional Attack Note.
Every scratch remembers a road that never stopped.
Every 7th Chord triggers twice. The count persists between combats.
The seventh beat always lands louder.
SLAY_THE_SPIRE2_MGR_MOD_RELIC_BLACK_GOLD: Whenever a Performance card finishes, gain {Gold:diff()} Gold.
SLAY_THE_SPIRE2_MGR_MOD_RELIC_GUITAR_PIC: Whenever a Chord triggers, gain 1 Block.
One gentle stroke, and the lingering note turns aside a blow.
SLAY_THE_SPIRE2_MGR_MOD_RELIC_PALE_FLOWE: At the start of combat, add 1 [color=#c8c8c8]Pale[/color] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Even withered, it bends toward a song it cannot hear.
SLAY_THE_SPIRE2_MGR_MOD_RELIC_MAGUROYAKI: Whenever you Smith at a Rest Site, heal {Heal:diff()}% of your Max HP.
Is the filling sweet bean paste, or tuna?
SLAY_THE_SPIRE2_MGR_MOD_RELIC_LITTLE_ANG: At the start of your turn, if your initial draw contained fewer than {SkillThreshold:diff()} Skills, draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
When the horn sounds, the late notes hurry to catch up.
